edges.reason: msg.sender is returned by _msgSender.
Fallback passes _msgSender() as the beneficiary argument.
Fallback invokes buyTokens on every plain ETH transfer.
beneficiary parameter flows into the purchase logic.
beneficiary is validated by _preValidatePurchase.
weiAmount local is assigned from msg.value inside buyTokens.
buyTokens calls _preValidatePurchase before computing tokens.
buyTokens converts weiAmount to tokens via _getTokenAmount.
weiAmount is passed to _getTokenAmount for rate multiplication.
_rate is multiplied by weiAmount; overflow is mitigated by SafeMath.mul.
_getTokenAmount result is stored in the tokens local variable.
_weiRaised is increased by weiAmount using SafeMath.add.
tokens is forwarded to _processPurchase.
buyTokens calls _processPurchase to deliver tokens.
_processPurchase delegates delivery to _deliverTokens.
_deliverTokens transfers tokens through SafeERC20.safeTransfer.
_token state variable is the target of the safeTransfer call.
_token is passed as the token argument of safeTransfer.
tokenAmount parameter is transferred to the beneficiary.
safeTransfer builds calldata and calls callOptionalReturn.
token parameter supplies the call target address.
data parameter supplies the raw calldata for the low-level call.
callOptionalReturn requires address(token).isContract() before calling.
account parameter is hashed by isContract.
callOptionalReturn performs an external low-level call on the token contract, which may execute arbitrary code.
The token contract can reenter via the low-level call before state finalization.
buyTokens forwards the collected ETH after processing the purchase.
_forwardFunds executes the ETH transfer to the wallet.
_wallet state variable is the recipient of the ETH transfer.
External ETH transfer to _wallet may attempt to reenter buyTokens, which is mitigated by the nonReentrant guard.
The nonReentrant modifier wraps buyTokens.
_notEntered flag is read and written by the nonReentrant modifier.
buyTokens invokes _updatePurchasingState hook.
buyTokens invokes _postValidatePurchase hook.
transfer calls the internal _transfer routine.
_msgSender() is used as the sender in transfer.
recipient parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
amount parameter is forwarded to _transfer.
sender parameter indexes _balances in _transfer.
_balances mapping is debited and credited with SafeMath checked arithmetic.
transferFrom calls _transfer for the value movement.
transferFrom updates the allowance through _approve.
_allowances is read and reduced with SafeMath.sub in transferFrom.
_approve writes the new allowance into _allowances.
account parameter is the mint destination.
amount parameter is the minted quantity.
_mint credits _balances[account] with SafeMath.add.
_mint increases _totalSupply with SafeMath.add.
_burn decreases _totalSupply with SafeMath.sub.
KappaToken constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
GammaToken constructor calls _mint for the initial supply.
msg.sender is the mint recipient in the KappaToken constructor.
KappaToken constructor executes the 80000e18 _mint operation.
GammaToken constructor executes the 80000e18 _mint operation.
KappaCrowdsale constructor invokes the Crowdsale base constructor.
GammaCrowdsale constructor invokes the Crowdsale base constructor.
KappaCrowdsale constructor deploys a new KappaToken.
GammaCrowdsale constructor deploys a new GammaToken.
AllCrowdsale field initialization deploys the KappaCrowdsale instance.
AllCrowdsale field initialization deploys the GammaCrowdsale instance.
rate parameter is stored into _rate.
wallet parameter is stored into _wallet.
token parameter is stored into _token.
Constructor assigns _rate state variable.
Constructor assigns _wallet state variable.
Constructor assigns _token state variable.
weiAmount parameter is multiplied by the rate in _getTokenAmount.
weiAmount parameter is checked for non-zero value in _preValidatePurchase.
sendValue performs the low-level ETH call to recipient.
recipient.call.value() forwards all gas and can reenter the calling contract.

normalization_plan.reason: beneficiary is only meaningful as the purchase recipient argument of buyTokens.
weiAmount local is derived from msg.value inside buyTokens.
tokens local exists only inside the buyTokens body.
tokenAmount is only used by _deliverTokens for the token transfer.
Parameter is consumed by the rate multiplication in _getTokenAmount.
rate is a constructor input assigned to _rate.
wallet is a constructor input assigned to _wallet.
token is a constructor input assigned to _token.
recipient is an argument of the public transfer function.
amount is an argument of the public transfer function.
account is the mint destination inside _mint.
amount is the minted value inside _mint.
token supplies the low-level call target in callOptionalReturn.
data supplies the raw calldata of the low-level call.
